4.4.4
Chunking Module
After extracting text, the system splits documents into meaningful chunks.
The implemented strategies include:
1. Fixed Size Chunking
2. Recursive Chunking
3. Semantic Chunking
These chunks improve semantic retrieval accuracy.
4.4.5
Embedding Module
Each chunk is converted into a numerical vector using the Sentence Transformer model.
The generated embeddings are normalized before indexing into FAISS.
4.4.6
Vector Database
The vector database stores document embeddings.
Features include:
• Persistent Storage
• Fast Similarity Search
• Workspace Isolation
• Incremental Updates
• Efficient Retrieval
4.4.7
Retrieval Module
The retrieval engine performs:
1. Query Embedding
2. Similarity Search
3. Ranking
4. Top-K Retrieval
5. Threshold Filtering
